0022600227.text: The Toronto Raptors (5-5, sixth in the East and 3.5 games back in the Atlantic, on a one-game losing streak) visit the Philadelphia 76ers (9-3, second in the East and 0.5 games back in the Atlantic, also on a one-game losing streak). Toronto is missing Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation), Nate Bittle (foot fracture), Scottie Barnes (groin soreness) and Trayce Jackson-Davis (illness), while Philadelphia is without Adem Bona (back sprain), Ariel Hukporti (Achilles surgery) and Dominick Barlow (back fracture), and Joel Embiid (foot) and LeBron James (back) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, with the Raptors losing the most recent meeting 115-102 in Toronto on January 12, 2026, and no games yet played in the 2026-27 series.
